title: CIA-UAP-008, Speculative Paper By N Kardashev and A Sakharov on Charged Mass in Space at Conference on Origins Of Life, Armenia, 6-8 September 1971/Low Scientific Level Of Other Soviet Papers
doc_notes: This document is a 1972 CIA Intelligence Information Report summarizing a US attendee's observations of a scientific conference in Armenia held in 1971.

incidents.summary: A Soviet committee member gave a talk regarding the investigation of flying saucers at a conference in Armenia.
incidents.quote: Another Soviet, who was a member of a committee the USSR has established to investigate unusual phenomena, in other words, flying saucers
